audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers read Skill / Gnar / Gnar / Skill / Skill / Gnar / Gnar. The packet and the mirror audit both say Gnar / Gnar / Gnar / Skill / Gnar / Gnar / Gwen. Rows 1, 6 (Level 6) and 7 (2+ items) are wrong, and they contradict the page's own prose: whys[0] says Mini wins the first trade outright, whys[4] says Mega kills her through mist at 6, whys[6] says she outscales hard at two items.
audit.why: A 55.29% win rate over 340 games with five of seven stages in Gnar's favour is not an EVEN lane either.
audit.corrected: Chart flipped as one atomic group in both layers to Gnar / Gnar / Gnar / Skill / Gnar / Gnar / Gwen, with ratings moved to match; diff moved EVEN to FAV at 7/10.

audit.why: Four spikes present and real: Lvl 2 pre-mist window, Lvl 4-5 Rage volatility, Lvl 6 Mega kill window, 2+ item Nashor's/Riftmaker flip.

audit.whatIsWrong: Hallowed Mist and Skip 'n Slash carry no cooldowns, and the itemization line calls Gwen's healing 'his' without naming the source.
audit.why: Hallowed Mist is 22/21/20/19/18s and it protects her only from enemies outside it — she must have it placed before your cast, so a 20s rank-3 gap is a real commit window. Skip 'n Slash is 13/12.5/12/11.5/11 and is partially refunded whenever she connects, so it is not a fixed clock. Her sustain is A Thousand Cuts, healing off the bonus magic damage on every auto against a champion, which is what makes Grievous Wounds timing decide extended trades.
audit.corrected: Both cooldowns and the mist-must-precede-the-cast rule written into the cooldown block and the do's; Oblivion Orb tied to A Thousand Cuts by name in itemization.
